label: Annual evapotranspiration (MODIS) — trend 2018→year (Sen's slope)
scale: linear, symmetric about 0 (fixed across years: 98th percentile of |slope|)
native_resolution: 500 m MODIS, rendered from ~1 km (0.01°) grid
source: MODIS MOD16A3GF v061 (annual, gap-filled) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
basis: annual total of the MODIS MOD16A3GF annual product (one value per year).
notes: Each image = per-pixel Theil-Sen (Sen's) slope of the yearly values from 2018 through the image year (>= 3 years), in mm/year per year. brown = drier / less water, teal = wetter / more water; white = no change. No significance test is applied per pixel: with 3-8 yearly points a slope is a description of change, not proof of a trend.
